TaskDescription: Passive viewing of an 8-min edited excerpt of Alfred Hitchcock's 'Bang! You're Dead' followed by a new/old recognition memory test on 40 movie frames with 1-6 confidence ratings (Keles et al. 2024).
Instructions: Watch the movie; then judge each frame as new or old with a confidence rating (1 = new, sure ... 6 = old, sure).

AntiAliasingLowPass.Description: Applied by the data authors before decimation from the 2000 Hz acquisition rate to 1000 Hz (Keles et al. 2024, Data Records). Not applied by this conversion.

HighPass.Description: Acquisition high-pass reported by Keles et al. (2024).

iEEGReference: Not documented by the source for macroelectrode channels (the publication describes referencing only for microwires); unknown.
iEEGElectrodeGroups: The source stores each macro contact as its own NWB ElectrodeGroup (Neuralynx-Atlas-macros-N). Contacts of one depth electrode share the lab label prefix (e.g. RAMY1..RAMY8 = right amygdala electrode); shaft membership is not stated explicitly in the source.
SoftwareVersions: n/a (acquisition software version not documented); conversion: laneB_ieeg005_bids.py with pybv 0.8.1
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically placed hybrid depth electrodes (orthogonal approach) targeting amygdala, hippocampus and medial frontal cortex; placement determined by clinical needs.
